Arizona fugitive arrested at LEGOLAND

The error is in the Plane of Cause (Q6). The suspect believed he could reset his history by changing his location (WHERE), ignoring that his actions (WHAT) carry a permanent causal weight.

The Unavoidable Truth: Violence against a partner is a permanent stain that no amount of travel can erase.

The Unavoidable Lie: That a change of scenery or a new identity can provide a clean slate for a violent offender.
